summary: Icon-only button for toolbar and utility actions; the default slot takes the icon.

usage.text: Unlike violet-button, it forwards no aria-expanded, aria-pressed, aria-haspopup or aria-controls to its inner button. For a toggle or popup trigger use violet-button with its ariaLabel property.

a11y.text: Set the label attribute: it is the inner button's only accessible name and also its hover title. Mark the slotted icon decorative.
